selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
Effective: 12 March 2019
Term: 36 months, then successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.

Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company; it sold sensors to us in 2018 and has no current MSA.

selection_rationale: Governing-contract judgment for INV-1002 and MSA-HELION-2019 uses the invoice billed_name, the named contract counterparty, and any explicit commercial-notes statement tying invoices to that agreement.
known_missing_information: world.sqlite is not present in workspace; compiled identity_judgment tuples from prior passes cannot be queried via TaskView.
No invoice-level contract reference field in billing source; governing contract must be inferred from counterparty name chain or commercial notes.
